description: This file contains the PHP class 'Module' which manages extension modules in the OpenCart admin panel. It provides methods for listing, installing, uninstalling, adding, and deleting modules, handling permissions, and managing module-related data and view rendering.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Controller class for managing modules in the OpenCart extension system, providing CRUD operations and integration with language, view, and permission systems.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Default method that sets the response output to the list of modules.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the list view of available, installed, and configurable modules.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installation of a new module, including language loading, database updates, permission assignments, and system registration.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles module uninstallation, cleaning up database entries, permissions, and system registrations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new module based on posted data, with validation and system registration.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a module identified by module_id or POST data, updating database and permissions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Save method is not explicitly present in the snippet.
